$comment: The contract of docs/diagrams/<view>/view.json. Diagrams.java validate reads THIS file and interprets a subset of JSON Schema 2020-12: type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties (false), items, minItems, minLength, pattern, oneOf, $ref to #/$defs and the non-standard x-fix (the sentence printed after an error). Anything else here is documentation. Every entity cites evidence (a fact id or a selector over facts); free text exists only in title, caption and a group's caption label. Design: .claude/decisions/0190-nerviz-diagrams-skill-derived-from-data.md
title: nerviz-diagrams view

kind.x-fix: kind is one of layers, classes, pipeline, territory

steps.x-fix: steps lists the ids of entities (fact ids), groups or edges ("<from>><to>") in the order the animation reveals them

emphasis.x-fix: emphasis lists the ids of entities (fact ids) or groups drawn with the heavier stroke

factId.x-fix: a fact id is <kind>:<name>, as listed in docs/diagrams/facts.json after `Diagrams.java facts`

id.x-fix: a group id is lowercase words joined by hyphens, never containing a colon (a colon marks a fact id)

groupLabel.x-fix: a group label is {"fact":"<id>"} or, as free text, {"caption":"<text>"}

node.x-fix: every entity is {"fact":"<id>"} or a selector {"from":"<path into facts>"}; free text belongs in title or caption, never in an entity

edge.x-fix: an edge is {"from":"<entity or group id>","to":"<entity or group id>","evidence":"<fact id>"} or {"derive":"depends_on"}
